name: provenance
description: Skills and agents for building Agent Skills, and for generating well-split, Conventional Commits-formatted git commits.

pr_sync_enabled.title: Auto-sync PR description after push
pr_sync_enabled.description: After a git push on a branch with an open PR, check whether the PR's title/description has drifted from the actual changes and offer to update it via the pr-description-sync skill. Off by default since it inspects and can edit a shared, visible PR.
